title: EgoTactile
about: A right-hand pressure glove with a head- or neck-mounted egocentric camera, single grasps of 63 everyday objects by 12 participants, plus a bare-hand subset.

hardware.d: 4×3 fingertip pads, one strip per finger, 72-taxel palm · 0–350 N · about 17 Hz, held on a 15 Hz clock
Plus participant sex and hand length

notes: Paper: arXiv 2606.09243 · project egotactile.github.io · code github.com/Russell-Zeng/EgoTactile. Videos are re-encoded to H.264 and redistributed under CC BY-NC 4.0 with attribution; the release ships MPEG-4 Part 2, which browsers cannot play. The glove model is not named in the paper. In the bare-hand subset the pressure comes from a synchronized off-camera gloved grasp.
